title: Huly code sync
description: A charcoal band with a quieter medium-weight heading, a code-host window mock (tabs, pull-request list with coloured labels) floating on a blue glow, and a 3×2 grid of points with glowing gradient icons and light two-line titles.
notes: dark by default (tone="dark" adds the dark class); its band uses the dark card colour
the window is a generic code host, not any real product's UI
